item.name: Downtown to Back Bay via Beacon Hill Walking Tour
item.unicode: Downtown to Back Bay via Beacon Hill Walking Tour
item.description:
Make Boston yours as we view its beauty, culture and history from its early beginnings to its striking 19th century architecture, as well as the special charm its unique neighborhoods still hold today. 

**Duration:**

- 2 hours

**Highlights of this 2 hour guided tour include:**

- The Freedom Trail's historic Revolutionary War era sites from Faneuil Hall to Boston Common
- The quirky, vibrant architecture and streets of  Downtown Boston
- Historic Beacon Hill's townhomes & gaslights
- The 19th century Back Bay area & Boston Public Garden
- Copley Square in all its beauty and grace


Come see how the upper echelon views the city from atop Beacon Hill, and gaze at the Swan Boats as they go under the world’s smallest suspension bridge while we stroll through the Public Garden.

Your guide will weave tales of the past, including the when, why and how the Back Bay was filled before you lose yourself in admiration of the elegant Copley Square.

At the end of the tour we'll set you loose in the Back Bay, a vibrant home to many a fine restaurant, shopping opportunity and cultural attraction. 

Ask your guide for recommendations before you have lunch at an outdoor café on Newbury Street, shop in Copley Place and Prudential Center, or visit one of Boston’s fine Back Bay museums.

**Meeting Location:**

The NW corner of State & Congress Streets outside 28 State Street (The Citizens Bank Building in Downtown Boston, MA)
item.booking_notes:
**Important Notice:** Please arrive at least 10 minutes before your scheduled tour time, as tours depart right on time.

**Meeting Location:** The tour will meet on the NW corner of State and Congress Streets, across from the Old State House (outside 28 State Street). Your Boston CityWalks Tour Guide will have either a dark shirt or jacket with the "Boston CityWalks" name and a dark blue "Boston CityWalks" cap. If you have any trouble locating the tour, please call 508.904.2819.

**What to Wear**

You will be outside for much of the tour, so dress for the forecasted weather! We recommend layers, as the temperatures can become higher throughout the day. (It's easy to peel a layer off!)
Wear comfortable walking shoes.
On sunny days, we suggest you use sunscreen. Hats and sunglasses can also be helpful.
If the weather forecast calls for rain or showers, rain jackets, umbrellas and hats can help. On most tours, the guide will have emergency ponchos available in case of unexpected inclement weather.
 
**What to Bring/What Not to Bring**

We suggest you bring a bottle of water with you. These can also be purchased at street vendors along the way. (If you intend to purchase water, be sure to bring some extra cash!)
If you have young children, it is highly recommended that you bring a folding carriage with you, as kids do get tired along the way.
And of course, BRING YOUR CAMERA!!
 
**Other Tips & Guidelines**

Please arrive at least 10 minutes before scheduled departure time.
If there are any particular types of things you would like to see or hear about, please get ready to let your guide know.
If you have any problems or questions prior to the tour, you can call our main number at 866-WE-WALKS. If you need to reach us close to tour time, call 508-904-2819.
Gratuities are not required, but certainly are welcome and appreciated!!
